rows.note: ME, TX and UT: 31 days. FL: payable for the first 20 days of confinement, then $10/$20 for the next 11 days depending on benefit level selected. Not payable for Mental/Nervous disorders and substance abuse (in UT, or substance disorder).

rows.label: Emergency accident benefit

values.*: $250 maximum benefit per injury, 4 per year — injury requiring emergency care by a physician in an emergency room or urgent care facility, treated within 72 hours of the injury

rows.note: Injury only. FL: maximum 2 per year, and payable only if you are confined as an inpatient within 24 hours of emergency treatment.

rows.label: Pregnancy

values.*: Covers complications of pregnancy, but not the pregnancy itself

rows.note: In FL, MD, MS, NM and OH the policy covers pregnancy and complications of pregnancy.
